Name: Primal Pride Paintings
Author: EnbyFelix
Description:
Adds 154 retextures of the "Primal Motion" painting as pride flags.
To get the pride paintings, you use the paint bucket purchased from Robin on the "Primal Motion" painting.
There is a list of the flags in the articles tab, it is also in the mod files.

I have been working on this for a long time, hope y'all like it. Happy Pride Month! <3
